security_audit.summary: All static external-command findings are false positives from Markdown code fences used as examples. The high-entropy findings are also false positives because the files are readable multilingual Markdown. One low-severity privacy risk remains because the skill requires web searches that may send learner-provided expressions to external services.

remediation.issue: Mandatory web search can disclose user-provided language content.
remediation.suggestion: Make web search optional for sensitive text and ask users before searching exact phrases from private messages or essays.

semantic_findings.title: Mandatory Web Search May Expose Learner Text
semantic_findings.description: The skill instructs the assistant to always use web search for examples and for proposed correction phrases. If users provide private sentences, related text may be sent to search providers or external sites.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The instructions explicitly require web search at the cited lines, so external disclosure of query text is plausible. The risk is limited because the search is for language examples, not secrets or credentials.

content.user_title: Improve Chinese Fluency with Native Examples
content.value_statement: Intermediate learners often know grammar but miss natural phrasing. This skill analyzes expressions, revises writing, and finds real examples from Chinese web sources.
actual_capabilities: Analyzes Chinese expression formality, spoken or written fit, audience, and common platforms.
Explains why native phrasing sounds natural using simple practical language.
Suggests alternate expressions with nuance, frequency, and regional notes when relevant.
Revises learner writing for fluent, context-appropriate Mandarin.
Finds recent web examples and cites sources when search tools are available.
Uses local guides for expression choice, composition technique, and search strategy.
limitations: Web examples depend on search access and source availability.
The skill targets HSK4-level and higher learners, not absolute beginners.
Current slang and regional usage may need fresh search verification.
Ambiguous writing tasks may require purpose, audience, and formality details first.

use_cases.title: Understand a Native Phrase
use_cases.description: Analyze a phrase from bilibili, Weibo, chat, or video subtitles and learn when it is natural to use.

use_cases.title: Rewrite Learner Writing
use_cases.description: Turn textbook-like sentences into fluent Chinese for chat, essays, messages, or spoken practice.

use_cases.title: Prepare Teaching Examples
use_cases.description: Collect alternatives, usage notes, and sourced examples for lessons about natural Mandarin expression.

prompt_templates.title: Analyze a Phrase
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze the phrase "搞定了". Explain formality, spoken or written use, natural context, alternatives, and three real examples.

prompt_templates.title: Improve a Message
prompt_templates.prompt: Please rewrite this Chinese message for a friend. Keep it casual and natural: 我昨天去了电影院，看了一个很好的电影。

prompt_templates.title: Compare Expression Choices
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare 有意思, 有点儿意思, 挺有意思的, and 有趣. Explain the tone, use cases, and mistakes learners often make.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Source-Cited Review
prompt_templates.prompt: Check how native speakers use "太绝了" online. Include recent examples, platform context, tone, safer alternatives, and source links.

output_examples.output: The skill explains that the phrase is casual and mainly spoken. It gives alternatives such as 挺有意思的 and 有趣, then adds sourced examples.

output_examples.input: Rewrite: 我认为这个电影非常好看。
output_examples.output: A likely correction is 我觉得这部电影挺好看的. The skill explains the more natural verb, measure word, degree word, and sentence-final tone.

output_examples.input: Help me write a friendly chat message in Chinese.
output_examples.output: The skill asks about audience and tone, then provides a concise native-style version with optional casual variants.

best_practices: Provide the expression, situation, audience, and desired tone.
Ask for web-sourced examples when current usage matters.
Specify mainland, Taiwan, or broad Mandarin usage when region matters.
anti_patterns: Do not paste private messages if exact web search examples are requested.
Do not ask for one perfect translation without context.
Do not treat casual expressions as safe for business or academic writing.

faq.question: Who is this skill for?
faq.answer: It is for HSK4-level and higher Mandarin learners who want more natural expression and writing fluency.

faq.question: Does it use web search?
faq.answer: Yes, the skill asks for web search when real examples or current usage are important and tools are available.

faq.question: Can it proofread essays?
faq.answer: Yes. Provide the purpose, audience, formality, and text so it can revise for natural flow.

faq.question: Can it explain slang from bilibili or Weibo?
faq.answer: Yes. It can analyze tone, context, safe use, and examples for online expressions.

faq.question: Does it teach full grammar lessons?
faq.answer: It can explain grammar when needed, but its main focus is natural usage and fluent wording.

faq.question: Is it safe for private text?
faq.answer: Avoid exact web search with private text. Ask the assistant to skip browsing or use generalized phrases.
